Indications
Parenteral nutrition is indicated in those clinical situations where 
the patient is unable to meet nutritional needs either by an oral
diet or through the use of enteral nutrition. Th e clinical condi-
tions that may require parenteral nutrition include an inability to 
digest and absorb nutrients, such as in massive bowel resection
